title: Record the selected owner slice ledger
body:
## Summary
- The selected owner file has 69120 rows, and each of the 144 calls uses helpers 0 through 479 once.
- The slices are prefix-packed and use 537120 of 774144 declared capacity. Their unused suffixes are the selected idle histogram `{1: 2276, 3: 377, 7: 7, 48: 4866}`.
- 17217 bins are shared by more than one call. The bin `(0, 6, 85)` has capacity 32 and used width 31. No new kappa.
